title: The Arcade pt. 2
content: A few days ago I posted an image very close to the arcade I visit in Mall World - in fact not only do I spend the most time there, I actively seek it out. I don’t know what I’m looking for there but I’m very much drawn to it. This here is a much more accurate depiction of what it looks like. Dusty, dingy, in disrepair, with the only light coming in from the windows. It’s almost like a symbol of lost or forgotten innocence I wish to hopelessly reconnect with, but it’s just too far gone.
